title: Every $20 AI coding plan compared: Claude, Codex, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax
description:
All major AI coding agent plans are priced at $20/month. 

But the subsidy ratio, how much API value you get vs what you pay, ranges from 7.6x (Claude Pro) to 33x (MiniMax) and 27x (Codex).
Kimi's 8x ratio still delivers more monthly tokens than Codex because the underlying API price is substantially cheaper per token.

Practical tip: Kimi, GLM, and MiniMax all officially support Claude Code as a harness; two env vars and you're pointed at a different model backend without changing your workflow.
Data from a proxied token measurement across real Claude Code workloads.

#aiengineering #claudecode #codex #developer #aiengineer
